result.description: High-speed 24GB dual-channel memory kit designed for compact desktop systems and content creation workloads. Runs at 6400MT/s with low-latency timings and supports Intel XMP 3.0 and AMD EXPO profiles for easy tuning. The aluminum heat spreaders help maintain stable thermals during sustained operation, while onboard power management improves efficiency and signal integrity.
